shortDescription: Add and remove Networks from a ND managed VXLAN fabric.

options.name: _fabric_details
options.description: INTERNAL PARAMETER - DO NOT USE Fabric details dictionary automatically provided by the action plugin Contains fabric_type, cluster_name, and nd_version information This parameter is used internally by the action plugin for MSD/MFD fabric processing

options.name: config
options.description: List of details of networks being managed. Not required for state deleted

options.name: deploy_mode
options.description: Controls the deployment method when deploy is enabled When set to 'switch' (default), deployments use switch-level API with serial numbers When set to 'resource', deployments use resource-level API with network names Multicluster parent network deployments use resource-level API internally Applies to both create/deploy and delete/undeploy operations

options.name: fabric
options.description: Name of the target fabric for network operations

options.name: state
options.description: The state of ND after module completion.
